about_the_game:
Once Upon a Time…

Jánoska’s brothers have already set off to make their fortunes. Now it is his turn. With little more than curiosity and a big heart, he wanders into the nearby village in search of opportunity… and immediately finds trouble.

When Jánoska finally sets off to make something of himself, his journey begins with seemingly small tasks in a quiet village. Yet these humble beginnings quickly lead him into a world of old magic and strange stories.

One day the town crier arrives with astonishing news!

The king of Behind the Beyond is looking for a suitor for his daughter, the Princess. So he proclaims the legendary Three Trials, challenges so daunting that few believe anyone could survive them. But for the youngest son, this may be the chance to win half a kingdom and the hand of a princess.

Magic, Choices & a Clever Fox Companion

Beyond the classic point & click actions, Jánoska can rely on charm, dexterity, or sheer strength to overcome the obstacles in his path. How you approach each challenge shapes the opportunities that await you later in the adventure.

As the journey continues, a new perspective opens with the arrival of the Fox, a second playable character whose keen senses and magical talents reveal possibilities hidden from human eyes.

Together, their different skills allow you to experiment, adapt, and discover your own way through a living folklore world full of secrets.

Time Waits for No One

As time ticks, the day-night cycle influences what paths open, when secrets emerge, and how the world unfolds.

Always Time for a Round of Cards

Need to win respect or just settle an argument fairly? Challenge locals (even animals!) to Ulti, the clever, competitive Hungarian card game. Every tavern plays it, and with our tutorial included, soon you will too!

And yes, the same version lives on Steam separately, with added leaderboards and multiplayer fun! Check out Behind the Beyond: Ulti!

Tales Shared… by You

Planning to stream? Flip on Streamer Mode. Your viewers will see a password with which they can connect to your game via our companion site and vote on what you should do in your game. The most popular choice will be indicated to you in your game. No chat chaos, no setup drama, it's all integrated.

Why You’ll Stay for the Long Haul

Behind the Beyond combines folk-tale artistry and branching storytelling with clever puzzles, time-based world dynamics, and a fox you’d want at your side. It’s more than an adventure, it’s a folktale that’s yours to shape with every choice you make.

Key Features

  • Based on Hungarian folktales

  • 2 controllable characters

  • RPG-like skill-based interactions

  • Multiple puzzle solutions

  • Day-night cycle that affects gameplay

  • Built-in streamer mode

  • Ulti card game included

short_description: In a land of old tales and great heroes, the youngest son finally gets his turn. Join Jánoska and the Fox on a magical adventure inspired by Hungarian folktales where you explore cosy villages, enchanted woods, and face the Three Trials in your quest for half a kingdom (and maybe a princess).
